description: Extract ICP patterns from structured customer interview notes (customer, role, pain points, buying triggers, value realized and key quotes per interview): pain points, objections, buying triggers, value realized, champion roles and quotes kept word for word, with discovery questions and sector notes. It does not take full transcripts; give only the points and quotes you want analyzed.

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it

interview_notes.description: Structured interview notes: one object per interview with the customer (company or segment), the role of the person interviewed and the points and quotes to analyze

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell, used for sector notes

name: icp_interview_synthesizer
title: ICP Interview Synthesizer
